name: Qi An Xin Technology Group Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Beijing, China, Qi An Xin Technology Group Inc. operates as a leading cybersecurity firm, delivering a broad spectrum of advanced technologies, products, and services. Its comprehensive solutions cater to a diverse clientele across China, including governmental bodies, corporate enterprises, the military, educational institutions, and financial sectors. These offerings encompass systems for threat detection, alarming, and auditing, alongside endpoint security management, unified cybersecurity situation awareness platforms, and robust perimeter defense solutions. Furthermore, Qi An Xin develops sophisticated tools for real-time global threat intelligence, providing tracking systems for distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) and phishing attacks, monitoring for Trojan horse viruses, and comprehensive global network scan surveillance.
